_comment: Paper-trading lab. No broker connection anywhere in this repo: every fill is simulated. Rules are fixed per rules_version; changing a strategy or risk number means bumping rules_version and paper_start so live paper results never mix two rule sets.

costs._comment: ESTIMATES, not quotes. Crypto: long-only because Robinhood crypto cannot be shorted; 0.30%/side stands in for Robinhood's spread markup, plus 0.02% slippage. Futures: $0.85/side/contract all-in commission+exchange fees, plus 1 tick slippage per side. Raise these if in doubt: optimistic costs are how paper edges appear.

risk._comment: Deterministic and applied to every order before it is simulated. Nothing a model outputs can change these.

strategies._comment: Pre-declared parameters, never optimised on this data. flat and hold are the baselines every strategy must beat after costs.

news._comment: Headlines are stored from day one; Jev judges them (shadow only) once an API key exists, backlog included.
